# 1375. Number of Times Binary String Is Prefix-Aligned

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def numTimesAllBlue(self, flips):
        """
        :type flips: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = cur_max = 0
        for i, flip in enumerate(flips, 1):
            cur_max = max(cur_max, flip)
            ans += (cur_max == i)
        return ans
```
